Commentary.Commentary: Big task ahead for the Proteas. A revised target of 308 isn't an easy one in normal situations as it is, gunning it down in 39 overs is a bigger challenge. The task might get more difficult if the rain intervenes again, so the Saffas will want a brisk start without losing much wickets. The chase is set up to be an exciting one. Don't go anywhere, it'll begin shortly...

South Africa were put under the pump today and they couldn't rise up to the occasion. Certain new players were brought in and everyone, including the regulars, were taken to the cleaners. Wickets were shared all around, though they didn't come at vital times and the runs couldn't be contained. Both Thisara and Shanaka blasted their respective fifties in the death overs, which should say a lot in itself.

Sri Lanka have done in 39 overs what they were struggling to do in 50 overs - get to the 300-mark. After a rather stop-start beginning to the game, whereby the overs were reduced to 39 eventually, Dickwella and Tharanga powered the Lankans off to a fast start. It laid the platform for the rest to capitalize on. The wickets might have kept falling, but the partnerships made were fast ones. 31 between Tharanga and Mendis, then 59 between Mathews and Kusal Perera. The big one though came late between Thisara and Shanaka, wherein they blasted 109 in 70 balls to power Sri Lanka past 300.

No, he cannot. Dot ball to finish things. Length ball outside off, Akila moves across to scoop it over the keeper's head but can't connect due to the lack of pace on it. At first everyone starts to go off, but the bowler just thinks the umpire is going to signal a wide for some reason. Doesn't happen, they continue to walk and SRI LANKA FINISH ON 306/7!
Length delivery around off, Thisara swings and gets it off the inner half through to deep mid-wicket for a single. Last ball of the innings. Can Akila finish big?
Driven towards mid on for a quick single. Off the mark.
Akila Dananjaya is the next batsman in.

OUT! Taken! Shanaka departs after a scintillating knock. Fuller ball on the off stump, he looks to go over the off side but can't get underneath the ball cleanly. Hits it straight to Mulder at cover-point. He departs, but not before playing a blinder. Partnership of 109 comes to a close.

300 on the board for Sri Lanka. Shanaka has been wonderful for Sri Lanka today. Knuckle ball on the hips, Dasun moves inside the line and with all his might, heaves it over backward square leg for a maximum.
9th ODI fifty for Thisara Perera! Length delivery outside off, cut down to short third man for a quick single. He's deserved this one, vital player for Sri Lanka.
FOUR! The 100-run stand is up. These two are going along strong. Shanaka swings this length ball through the square leg region and finds the boundary line without any trouble.
In the air again but it lands safely. Shortish outside off, Dasun lofts it high over point. Lands safely and a brace is taken.

SIX! His maiden ODI fifty and it's brought up in some style. What a hit from Shanaka. Slower ball, straight in line, no fielder out in the deep on the leg side so he goes for it. Swings hard and clears the square leg boundary for half a dozen.
FOUR! Oh wow. That is smashed. Dasun Shanaka on the charge. Short of a length outside off, he stands his ground and bludgeons it over the covers for a boundary.

FOUR! That's innovative from Dasun Shanaka. All vital runs for Sri Lanka. Full and just outside off, he walks across and scoops it over short fine leg. One bounce and it's across the rope for a boundary.
Full and fired on middle and off, drilled to long on. Single taken.
Too full aiming the base of off stump, Perera smacks it past the bowler. Long off is out there, he moves to his left and keeps the batsmen to a single.
Full outside off, Shanaka drives it to extra cover and rushes to the other end. There is a shy at the bowler's end but it misses.
Lofted down towards long off for just one this time.

SIX! A mishit and it's still gone all the way. The man has a lot of power in him, doesn't he? The crowd's loving it. Slower length on off, Thisara throws the kitchen sink at it and gets it off the top edge. Clears long off somehow and that's the second one of the over.
On the fuller side of the length, around off, smacked hard but straight to mid off.

SIX! That's outta here! Short ball angling in on off, Thisara rocks on the back foot in a jiffy and pulls it with all his might. Clears the fence with ease and sends it deep into the mid-wicket stands.
Full again, angling in on middle and leg, Thisara stays leg side and lofts it over covers for a run.
In the air but it's well short. Fuller from Dala, Shanaka off the toe end lofts it down towards long on for a single.
Dances down the track to the length ball and hits it towards mid on.
Length delivery close to off, Perera gets an inside edge down to fine leg for a single.
A big swing across the line from Perera but he gets it off the outer half through point. Free Hit, so no harm done either way. Picks up two for it.
Free Hit coming up...
No ball! Dala dishes out a high full toss on the stumps, Shanaka swings across the line to put it away but can only get it away on the leg side. Single taken and no ball signalled for height.
SIX! BANG! Shanaka wastes no time in putting this away. Welcomes Dala with a biggie. Short ball, Dasun pulls this over mid-wicket for a maximum.
Junior Dala comes back on.
Thisara looks to smash this out of Kandy but connects only with thin air. Fuller length ball just outside off, the southpaw swings with all his might but can't put any bat on ball.
Slower one, landed on a length outside off, run down towards third man for a single.
Length delivery in the channel outside off, Thisara punches it a bit square through the off side and crosses over.
Worked away on the leg side for a single.
Wide! The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. Wide signalled by the umpire. Fifty-run stand comes up. Can these two take Sri Lanka close to 300?
Slower and outside off, cut through point for a single.
FOUR! Comes from around the wicket and fires it full on off, Thisara smashes this straight back past the bowler. Hit so hard, nobody in the deep has any chance to stop it. Wow.
Lungi Ngidi to bowl.
Leans ahead to this fuller ball and drives it towards mid off for a single.
Wide! Way outside off, across the tramline, wide signalled by the umpire.
Fuller on the stumps, driven back down the track for no run.
Smacks this flat down to long on and gets to the other end.
Length ball outside off, Dasun opens the face and dabs it behind point. Runs the first one hard so is able to come back for the second as a result.
Full and wide outside off, driven to deep cover for one run.
Fullish in length and darted just outside off, Shanaka closes the bat face and works it through the vacant spaces in the mid-wicket region for one run.
Short of a length ball punched off the back foot. They pick up a single at covers.
Full length ball driven to mid off. They pick up a single.

NOT OUT! Shanaka is safe. Length ball angling in, the batsman is late on the shot and seems to get a faint inside edge as the ball goes down to fine leg. The batsmen in the meantime go for a single. Phehlukwayo appeals but it is turned down by the umpire. The bowler felt it hit his pads first and convinced de Kock to go for the review. Replays show that there is bat involved and South Africa lose their review.
Review taken for an lbw. Dasun Shanaka is the man in question. Quinton de Kock wants to check if it's pad first or not. Let's see...
SIX! Short ball, he goes for the pull and connects sweetly as the balls flies over the deep square leg boundary for a six.
Length ball outside off, Thisara reaches out and gives it everything but does not time it well, fielder at covers runs back but fails to get his hands to it.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.
FOUR! Full and wide outside off, Shanaka lofts that over mid off. The ball has crossed the ropes.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Overpitched ball wide outside off, Thisara goes for the expansive drive but finds the fielder at sweeper cover who keeps it down to a single.
Full on middle and off, played back to the bowler.
Length ball on the stumps, the batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
Length ball on the pads, Thisara gets inside the line and flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Willem Mulder is brought back into the attack.
Stands tall as this is landed on a back of a length outside off. Thisara punches it to sweeper cover for a run.
Outside off again, another play and a miss.
Big swing and a miss from the batsman. Thisara looks to go big across the line to this short of a length ball, misses it altogether.
Hits this really hard but unfortunately finds the fielder. Length ball around off, Thisara slaps this hard to mid off.
Width offered outside off, Shanaka cuts it down behind point and brings Thisara back on strike.
Slower length delivery just outside off, Shanaka opens the bat face and dabs it to point.
Andile Phehlukwayo to bowl again.
Manages to whip this just wide of the fielder in the same area and gets a single.
Tucks it to the mid-wicket area but for no run this time.
SIX! He can hit a few. Nicely tossed on around off, Shanaka takes a step across, gets low and slog sweeps the turning ball with the spin over square leg. Short boundary out there, nicely done.
Plants his front foot forward and pushes it back to the bowler.
Flicks it away through mid-wicket and gets off strike.
FOUR! Positive cricket from Thisara Perera. Keeping the boundaries coming is important. Waits for the bad ball as it's dropped short. He rocks back and muscles it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Blocked out comfortably. It's attacking the stumps, Dasun stays behind the line and offers a defensive bat in response.
Slower and down the leg side, worked to fine leg. One more to the total.
The 200 is up! Sri Lanka need to get a move on in these last 10 or so overs. Shanaka wrists it through square leg and rotates strike.
Full and down the leg side, flicked to fine leg for one off the pads. So it's a leg bye.
Length ball kicking off the surface, on off, it takes the outside edge of the bat and rolls down to third man. Single collected.
Full in line of the stumps, pushed back down the track off the front foot.
Rock solid in defense. Good over from JP. 3 runs and a wicket off it. Full and loopy on the stumps, Thisara comes forward and blocks it out.
Full and outside off, safely guarded out.
Shanaka is off the mark. Leans forward and across before wristing it down to long on for a single.
Full toss around the pads, worked away on the leg side for a single.
Dasun Shanaka to bat next.

OUT! Kusal Perera has been dismissed at a crucial time for the Lankans. Needed to stay out there, at least a little longer, if not till the end. He skips down the track and lofts it over wide mid on. Doesn't have enough power on it as David Miller runs to his left from long on and slides to take a safe catch.
Quick, flat and short outside off, cut through towards sweeper cover. One run collected.
Pushes this full length ball down the ground with the full face of the bat and picks up a single.
Wide! Angles it down the leg side from around the wicket, wide called by the umpire.
Picks it off his pads and works it away on the leg side.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Short of a good length on off, played back off the inner half to the left of the bowler.

Good effort from Andile. Short and outside off, Thisara throws his bat at it and cuts it over the vacant slip cordon. Phehlukwayo from third man moves to his right and slides to make a good stop. The umpire checks it upstairs and replays show he's just fine. Two to the total.
Boundary? The umpire is checking it upstairs...
FOUR! Smacked! Shot. Back of a length close to off, Thisara stands tall and slaps it down the ground. Straight back, the two men in the deep can't stop it.
Junior Dala returns.
Spinning away from around off, on a shorter length, punched down the ground to long off for one.
Goes back and works it through backward square leg for a single.
Full and down the leg side, Kusal closes the face early and gets a leading edge back to the bowler.
Slower through the air and fullish on the stumps, Kusal is forward in defense.
Goes back to the flatter ball and works it in front of square leg for a single.
Fuller from around the wicket, on middle and off, played back to the bowler.
Thisara Perera to be the new man in. Also, JP Duminy comes back into the attack.

OUT! Loose shot by de Silva as he half-heartedly drives a full length ball in the air, way outside off and the elevation takes the ball all the way to the man at sweeper cover boundary. Sri Lanka now have half the side back in the hut as the man in-form departs cheaply.
The batsman defends this length ball from within the crease.
11th ODI Fifty for Kusal Perera. Short of a length outside off, gets on top and punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! Straying on the pads and pays the price. Full ball angling in, but Perera gets the inside half on his flick shot and the ball runs very fine to the fine leg boundary.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Gets Lucky. Short of a length just outside off, stays on the back foot and opens the face, gets it finer than he intended to, between the slip and keeper. It runs away for a four.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
Drives this full ball back in the bowler's direction. Another dot.
Pushed quicker through the air on middle and off, blocked firmly in front of short cover.
Works it away through backward square leg for a single.
FOUR! Too much width offered outside off, Perera goes back and cuts it fiercely through point. Consecutive boundaries for him.

FOUR! In the gap and that's a boundary. Kusal Perera starts the over off in explosive fashion. Full outside off, he slogs this right off the meat over mid-wicket. Well wide of the man in the deep. Superb shot.
Short of length ball, pushed it to the cover fielder.
FOUR! And he is off the mark in style. Short of a length ball on the body, he plays a short-arm pull through mid-wicket, times it sweetly enough.
Length ball outside off, de Silva shoulders arms and lets it go.
Dhananjaya de Silva out in the middle next.
Drinks are on the field.

OUT! The big one is down. Lungi Ngidi picks up a vital wicket for his skipper and his team. Back of a length outside off, Mathews goes for the expansive drive on the up, gets a thick outside edge and de Kock does well to take a Superman-like catch diving to his right. This is the 2nd time in 3 ODIs that Mathews has fallen prey to Ngidi.
FOUR! Short of a length on off, Mathews walks down the track, goes through the line, gets good elevation over mid off and the ball runs over the ropes.
Bangs it short and wide from round the wicket, Perera rocks back and cuts it to deep point for a single.
Lungi Ngidi is back on. South Africa need a wicket here.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Drives it to mid off for no run.
SIX! Powerful hit from Kusal Perera! Short on the stumps, he goes on the back foot and muscles the pull over mid-wicket for a big maximum. That brings up the 50-run stand between these two as well.
Uses the wrists to turn it on the leg side.
Works it against the spin through mid-wicket for a single.

Wide! Appeal for a catch? Still a wide's been given. What's happened here? Replays show some pad. Sliding down leg, Mathews misses the flick as the ball brushes the pads. Understandable why de Kock appealed.
SIX! That's how you play spin. Good use of the feet from the Lankan skipper. Gets out of the crease, close to the pitch and smokes it over long off. Well done, Mathews.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
Length ball on the pads, elegantly flicked to deep backward square leg for 2 runs.
Short ball on the body, Perera gets inside the line and swivel-pulls it to fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Length ball outside off, Perera drives on the up through covers for a beautiful boundary.
SIX! Majestic Pull, Mulder bangs it short into the body, Perera swivels quickly and pulls this ones over the deep square leg boundary.
FOUR LEG BYES! Length ball angling in on the pads from round the wicket, the batsman tries to flick it, misses, takes the deflection off the pads and runs down fine for a four.
Turned down to short fine leg. A brisk single is stolen as a shy is had at the striker's end. It misses, so no harm done in the end.
Spears it full, almost a yorker, probably trying to counter Perera's sweep. The batsman can only dig it out back to the bowler.
Flat, quick and short, skidding on the stumps, punched off the back foot to long on. One run collected.
Loopy and slow through the air outside off, pushed to short cover.
Drifting in from around the wicket, full and on middle and leg, Mathews plays it off the inner half to mid-wicket.
Spinning in on a fuller length, Perera goes with the turn and drags the sweep to deep backward square leg for a single.
Another bumper, this one is a legal one though. Mathews looks to take the pull shot on but the bounce gets too big on him.
Length ball on off, goes across the line with a pull to short mid-wicket.
Places the punch on the up straight to the cover fielder.
Wide! banged in short but it's too short. Mulder brings the short one out of nowhere and hits the deck hard. Too hard it seems. Over the batsman's head and that's a wide.
Fired in full on the stumps, Angelo drills it to the man at short cover.
Back of a length outside off, punched to sweeper cover for one more.
Wide! Angles it too far down, down the leg side, wide called.
FOUR! Picks his spot and takes the aerial route. Full and angling in on middle from around the wicket, Perera lofts it cleanly over mid-wicket and beats the man in the deep. Excellent placement.
Perera forces this towards mid on and changes ends.
Short and flat, turning away, Mathews goes back and offers a firm punch through towards sweeper cover for one.
Full and just outside off, Perera tries to drive it back down the ground but it goes off the edge through the vacant slip cordon. Just the single results.
Comes forward and knocks it to long on for a single.
Too full and quick on middle and leg, driven straight to the man at mid on.
Quicker and fuller outside off, spinning in, Perera gets low and sweeps it off the inner half in front of square leg for a single.
FOUR! Good shot as he smashes a full length delivery straight down the ground. The timing takes the ball past the long on boundary.
Short of a length, Mathews opens the face and dabs it to the point fielder.

DROPPED! Much easier than the one dropped by Klassen earlier. Mathews drives a length ball on the up. Ball seems to stop a bit and presents Mulder with a catch who hangs his left hand out, the ball hits the top of his palm and goes down. How much will this cost SA?
Short of a length on the stumps. Mathews goes back and blocks it.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends this short of a length ball off the back foot.
Full ball on the stumps, Mathews plays it straight to the bowler who throws it back at the stumps.
Wide! Banged in short but misses his line as he strays this one way down the leg side for a wide.
Goes with the spin and pushes it to the cover region. Single to end the over as Mathews gets going.
Angelo Mathews next in to bat.

OUT! And gone! Maharaj strikes in his very first over. Keeps it full and straight, in line of the stumps, Mendis is down on his rear knee to sweep it away but misses it altogether. Caught flush in front of pads and the appeal goes up. The umpire's finger follows not too long after and Mendis has to walk back. Sri Lanka in a slight spot of bother here.
Dabs it to point for nothing.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single. The 100 comes up for Sri Lanka.
A lot of flight on this from Maharaj, Mendis goes across the line with a swipe and places it through mid-wicket for a double.
Floated delivery on the stumps, pushed just wide of the bowler.
Keshav Maharaj to roll his arm over.
Length ball angling in, batsman fails to make contact, gets hit low on the pads. Tries to turn it to the on side, but the ball hits the pads and they run for a quick single. Leg bye signalled.
FOUR! That's how Perera likes to play, length ball just outside off, the left-hander punches it straight with power and beats Ngidi to the boundary.
Back of length slanted in the body, Perera misses the flick and the ball raps his thigh pad.
Kusal Perera to join Kusal Mendis in the middle. This could be a 'Kusal' partnership for Sri Lanka.

OUT! What a delivery from Mulder. Superb. This surface wasn't supposed to have anything in it for the pacers but the rain has completely changed the game. The ball is doing all sorts of things now. Length delivery angling in from round the wicket, Tharanga looks to play at it but misses it completely as the ball rattles the stumps, after going through the gate. Sri Lanka lose their 2nd wicket.
SIX! Length ball outside off and Tharanga drives on the up through the line over mid off, great elevation and super timing takes it over the boundary for a maximum.
Full ball on middle, Mendis flicks it straight to deep square for a single.
Willem Mulder is introduced into the bowling attack.
Terrific placement. Mendis waits the short ball outside off, backs away and cuts it late past short third man. Ngidi chases it down and keeps it just inside the rope. Saves a run for his side.
Spinning in from around off, tad shorter in length, Mendis is behind the line as he pushes it towards mid on.
Straighter one, on middle and leg, clipped through square leg for one more.
Positions himself well behind the line and pushes it out defensively.
Leans ahead and drives it down to long off. Gets to the other end with a single.

SIX! Clean strike. Kusal Mendis has made his intentions known without wasting time. Positive batting from him. Sees the ball tossed up in his area, he gets low and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket to send it deep into the stands.
FOUR! Superb. Back-to-back boundaries to end the over. Short and well outside off, Tharanga cuts it down fine aerially and sends it across the third man fence for a boundary.

FOUR! Shot. Got good power behind it and the placement was fine as well. Just behind a length, on the stumps, Tharanga shapes up for the shot and pulls it through mid-wicket to send it across the boundary line.
Wide! Way outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone. The umpire signals a wide.
Uses the angle into him and works it away through square leg for a run.
Skidding off the surface again. Length ball on middle and leg, heaved off the inner half through to deep mid-wicket. One more taken.
Cutting back in from a length, Mendis tucks it behind square on the leg side. One run to the total.
Skidding off the deck as Andile serves it on a length outside off, Mendis looks to cut but misses.
Mendis is off the mark. He leans ahead and wrists it to mid on for a single.
Fires it quicker, going down leg, Mendis is caught on the pads as he misses his attempted sweep shot. No appeal made.
Goes with the spin as Duminy comes over the wicket, worked away on the leg side.
Kusal Mendis walks in at no.3.

OUT! What an anti-climatic end to Niroshan Dickwella's stay in the middle. The Sri Lankan openers were motoring along quite well, but the 61-run stand has come to an end. Slower through the air and fuller on off, Dickwella leans forward and across to play the paddle sweep but gets it off the top edge. It pops up as he played it too early and de Kock takes the simplest of catches in the vacant short leg area.
Through the covers again, along the carpet this time. Single to the total.
Tharanga goes inside out. Tossed up just outside off, Upul opens his body up a bit and lofts it over the covers. Wide long off comes across to his right and stops the boundary. The batsmen take two.
Short of a length angling across, Tharanga glides this rising delivery to third man
Short and attacking the stumps, Tharanga goes for the pull but does not time it cleanly, fielder runs across and restricts them to two.
Tries to run a length ball outside off towards third man, misses as the ball nips away a bit to beat the bat.
FOUR! Overpitched delivery on middle and off, Tharanga chips it over mid off and the timing is good enough to take it past the boundary.
Length ball outside off, Tharanga tries to blast it straight on the up but finds mid off, no chance of a single.
Bangs it in short, angling away, Tharanga sways back and lets it go past to the keeper.
Tossed up from Duminy, it's kept out off the front foot safely.
Smart from JP. Seeing Dickwella position himself for the reverse sweep, he darts it full around leg, Dickwella still goes through with the shot but can only get it off the toe end on the off side.
Pushes towards short extra cover. Dot ball on this occasion.
Leans ahead and drives the full ball down to long off for a single.
A bit quicker through the air, around off, Tharanga looks to drive it through the covers but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Dipping full toss from around the wicket, outside off, Niroshan kneels down and drags the sweep through square leg for one.
JP Duminy on to have a go with the ball.
Bit too straight in line, on middle, worked in front of square leg for a single.
Hits the deck hard and bangs it in short, around off, Dickwella arches back to ramp it over the keeper's head but fails to connect.
Seaming off the deck, away from the batsman, Tharanga runs it down to third man and gets off strike.
Shaping away towards off on a back of a length, wristed away square on the leg side. One run taken.

Update 1755 local - The news is in. Play to begin now in 5 minutes. The match is reduced to a 39-over game. Both the openers stride out, with Phehlukwayo to continue. Dickwella on strike. Here we go...

Update 1725 local - So the covers are back on. Was just a slight drizzle at first, but then it picked up. Let's hope play starts back soon enough. We continue to wait. Random note - the floodlights continue to shine brightly.
Wide! Way down the leg side, wide called by the umpire. De Kock behind the stumps does well to move to his right and stop the ball.
Short and outside off, steered to point with an angled bat.

On the leg stump line, Tharanga walks across to play the flick shot but it goes off his pads. They take a leg bye as there is a shy at the striker's end. Needless as the batsman was well in. So, as a result, they take two more as the ball ricochets away.
Wide! Andile sprays it down the leg side, starts the over off loosely. The umpire signals wide.
Andile Phehlukwayo is into the attack now.

FOUR! Third of the over, 12 runs in total from this. Quite expensive from Junior Dala. It's pounded in shorter around off, Dickwella with an angled blade steers it behind the diving backward point fielder to send it across the boundary line.
FOUR! Full in length and attacking the stumps, Dickwella leans ahead and lofts it over the mid-wicket area for a boundary.
Hangs back inside the crease and keeps it out with a straight blade.
Fullish in length and outside off, going away, Dickwella drives it square to point.
FOUR! Short and it's pulled away! Into the body from Dala, Dickwella with a little swivel muscles it over the square leg region and finds the fence.
Cut in half! Some superb bowling from Junior Dala. He generates some serious pace as he lands it on a back of a length close to off, Dickwella is beaten for pace as he tries to put bat on ball.
Banged in short and it's angling across, Dickwella takes a step out of the crease and cuts it over backward point, towards third man. A run will let Niroshan keep strike.
Full ball in line of the stumps, Tharanga drives from the inner half, just wide of mid on. One run to the total.
Bit shortish outside off, cut square on the off side for no run.
Brings the wrists into play and flicks it away on the leg side for a single.
Takes some pace off this and lands this fuller around off, Dickwella drives it towards mid on from the inner half.
Beaten! Length delivery just around off, Dickwella looks to force it on the off side but gets beaten past the inside edge.
Driven this full delivery to mid off and ends the over with a dot ball.

That's a dropped chance but what an attempt! Heinrich Klaasen with a phenomenal effort. Wow. Tharanga drives this full ball on the up and chips it towards covers. Klaasen at extra cover moves to his left and dives full stretch. Gets his hands to it but just can't keep a hold of it.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and going away from the batsman, Tharanga plays the cover drive and misses.
A firm punch down the ground. Dickwella meets the full ball with the full face of the bat and drives it as mid off cuts across to his left and keeps the batsmen to one.
Wide! Fuller and down the leg side, Dickwella looks to flick but misses.
Fraction straight in line, worked away on the leg side for nothing.
Length again this time closer to the off pole, Tharanga watches it go through to the keeper.
FOUR! Class! He is very strong square of the wicket. Ngidi bowls one on the shorter length outside off, Upul stays back and cuts it through point. Boundary.
Another effort ball on middle and leg, Tharanga does well to leave it alone.
Another short ball down the leg side. Dickwella just helps it on it's way to the fine leg region. One run added to the total.
Back of a length ball on that fourth stump line, Dickwella hops a tad and bunts it down.
FOUR! Shot! Ngidi bangs this one short around middle and leg, Dickwella gets under it and pulls it through mid-wicket to the fence.
Length ball on the leg side, Tharanga turns his bat to the leg side to the mid-wicket fielder.
Wide outside off, hit to the cover-point region for nothing.
Length ball outside off, Tharanga tries cutting it but gets an inside edge to the on side. Thinks of the run but is sent back by his partner.
Fuller ball around off, Tharanga plays it to the cover region.
Drives this past the mid off region for another run.
Missed out on that. A low full toss on the leg side. Tharanga whips it away but cannot find the gap. Hits it to deep square leg for just a run.
Gets behind the ball and blocks it well.

FOUR! Lovely! All timing on that. Full and wide outside off, Dickwella opens the bat face and guides it through cover-point. Didn't hit it too hard but the ball raced to the fence. Even though with so much rain, the outfield was quick.
On the pads again, Upul flicks it towards fine leg to change ends.
Length ball on the legs, Tharanga taps it in front of him.
Better this time, gets this closer to the stumps, Tharanga shoulders his arms to this.
Short and wide outside off, Tharanga leaves it alone.
Length ball this time by Dala and outside off, Tharanga guides it down to third man for a run. End of a quick over by Dala.
Bowls a yorker on middle, Tharanga though maybe was expecting a fuller one as already a bouncer was signaled the ball before. He is upto the task and jams it out.
WIDE! Maybe this time he gets carried away by the bounce he is getting. Goes for another bumper, this time it bounces way above the batsman's head and it is wided.

EDGED but away from the second slip fielder. Just behind a length on the off pole. It slants away from the left-hander. Dickwella tries to defend but gets an outside edge down towards third man for a run.
On the fuller side this time by Dala, no swing on offer for the debutant. Dickwella lunges and pushes it to the man at covers.
Another excellent delivery! Shorter in length and on the body of the batsman. Dickwella strangely tries to fend it away but is beaten.
Starts off with a back of a length delivery, gets some good bounce off the surface. Niroshan lets it go through to the keeper.

Update 1648 local - The news is in that play will resume now. Only a few minutes gone by, but another two overs have been lost. Still a bit overcast out there, let's see how long this phase will last. Junior Dala will be bowling from the other end, with the second new ball.

Some bad news! THE RAIN IS BACK. And it's coming down quite heavily too. Seems like we're going to have a quite frustrating day from the looks of it. Grab your laptops and your smartphone, your cup of coffee and some crisps, we're in for a long day.
On the back foot again and it's worked away on the leg side. End of the first over.
Fraction straight in line, Lungi bangs it in short, Tharanga rises this time and works it down on the leg side.
Rises on his toes and dabs it away through point for a single.

FOUR! Edged and Sri Lanka are away! Full in length with some swing on offer from Ngidi. It goes away as Dickwella drives away from his body. Gets a thick edge and it flies past second slip for a boundary.
On the shorter side again, on off, Dickwella hangs on the back foot once more and defends it down.
Back of a length delivery angling across, Dickwella stays back and taps it down in front of point with an open face.

We are ready to begin. South Africa are in a team huddle with their stand-in skipper Quinton de Kock giving them one last pep talk. They spread out on the field as Niroshan Dickwella and Upul Tharanga stride out to the middle. Lungi Ngidi to take the new ball first up. It's got quite dark out there again, could rain once more. Two slips in place. Let's roll...

Angelo Mathews says they would have bowled first too. Feels the wicket looks dry but it settles down later. Mentions there's one change as Prabath Jayasuriya goes out for Dasun Shanaka. Ends by saying he wants his team to do better in all three aspects.

Quinton de Kock says they will have a bowl first. Mentions the wicket does get better under lights, hence the decision to bowl first. Informs there are three changes as Junior Dala comes in for Kagiso Rabada, Heinrich Klaasen for Faf du Plessis and Keshav Maharaj replaces Tabraiz Shamsi. States he wants to test the bench strength and hopes it's a good day for him as captain.
TOSS - South Africa win the toss and opt to field first!

Pitch Report - Kepler Wessels out in the middle says it's a great wicket. Adds that he thought due to the rain, there would be more moisture in it but that's not the case. Continues to say it's very level, very even and it's nice and hard. Reckons the surface looks excellent surface to bat on and the team winning the toss will look to have a go with the bat first. Feels there won't be much swing available, so change of pace will be key.

Hello and welcome to the coverage of the 4th game between Sri Lanka and South Africa. A dead rubber as the series is already decided but there is still a lot at stake. For Sri Lanka, they would want to win it, avoid a whitewash. For South Africa, they will want to keep the hopes of a whitewash alive. Also their new captain Quinton de Kock will be eager to win his first game. What will be the outcome? We will have to wait and find out. Stay tuned for the toss and teams.
